info.name: RingCentral Adaptive Cards Regional Settings API

params.name: allCountries
params.description:
If set to `true` then states of all countries are returned and
`countryId` is ignored, even if specified. If the value is empty
then the parameter is ignored

params.name: countryId
params.description: Internal identifier of a country

params.name: page
params.description:
Indicates a page number to retrieve. Only positive number values
are accepted

params.name: perPage
params.description: Indicates a page size (number of items)

params.name: withPhoneNumbers
params.description:
If `true` the list of states with phone numbers available for
buying is returned

items.docs: Returns all states of a certain country.

params.name: stateId
params.description: Internal identifier of a state

items.docs: Returns information on a specific state by ID.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Sorts results by the property specified

params.name: page
params.description:
Indicates a page number to retrieve. Only positive number values
are accepted

params.name: perPage
params.description: Indicates a page size (number of items)

params.name: stateId
params.description: Internal identifier of a state

params.name: withNxx
params.description: Specifies if `nxx` codes are returned

items.docs: Returns all available locations for a certain state.
Returns information about the supported languages.

params.name: languageId
params.description: Internal identifier of a language

params.name: page
params.description:
Indicates a page number to retrieve. Only positive number values
are allowed. Default value is '1'

params.name: perPage
params.description: Indicates a page size (number of items). If not specified, the value is '100' by default

params.name: timezoneId
params.description: Internal identifier of a timezone

items.docs: Returns information on a certain timezone.

params.name: loginAllowed
params.description:
Specifies whether the logging-in with the phone numbers of this country
is enabled or not

params.name: signupAllowed
params.description:
Indicates whether a signup/billing is allowed for a country. If
not specified all countries are returned (according to other
specified filters if any)

params.name: numberSelling
params.description: Specifies if RingCentral sells phone numbers of this country

params.name: page
params.description:
Indicates a page number to retrieve. Only positive number values
are accepted

params.name: perPage
params.description: Indicates a page size (number of items)

params.name: freeSoftphoneLine
params.description:
Specifies if free phone line for softphone is available for a
country or not

items.docs: Returns all countries available for calling.

params.name: countryId
params.description: Internal identifier of a country
